content: Statin therapy should be tailored based on the patient's cardiovascular risk profile, as recommended by the American Diabetes Association (ADA). If a patient is unable to tolerate the intended dose of statins due to side effects or other factors, alternative therapeutic options should be explored. In such cases, the use of PCSK9 inhibitors, which are monoclonal antibody treatments, may be considered as an adjunct or alternative to statin therapy. These agents can help achieve lipid-lowering goals in patients who are statin-intolerant or require additional lipid-lowering beyond what statins can provide.
